corrections.reason: The canonical Ge'ez verb in Matthew 27:20 is 'ኄጥዎሙ' (from ኄጠ, to persuade/beguile), and the printed glyph clearly shows 'ኄ' rather than 'ጌ'.
The Amharic idiom is 'እሽ በጂ አሰኟቸው' (6th order 'ሽ'), which matches the printed glyph.
The alternative Ge'ez reading 'እርስዮ' (subjunctive, translated as 'ምን ላድርገው') is printed with 6th-order 'ር', contrasting with indicative 'እሬስዮ' ('ምን አደርገዋለሁ').
The Ge'ez verbal noun from 'ጸርኀ' (to cry out) is 'ጸሪኀ' with 'ኀ', which is clearly visible in the print.
